title: Zephyr: recovery countdown
description: Implement recovery countdown for Zephyr C. Acceptance: Works with hardware timers.
close_reason: Implemented recovery countdown for Zephyr C using k_timer hardware timers. Added: (1) lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/recovery_countdown.h - API header with lichen_recovery_countdown struct and functions, (2) lichen/subsys/lichen/link/recovery_countdown.c - implementation using Zephyr k_timer for T_DRIFT_MAX and T_GIVE_UP countdown timers, (3) Added timer constants (LICHEN_T_DRIFT_MAX_SUPERFRAMES=6, LICHEN_T_GIVE_UP_SUPERFRAMES=10) to link.h. The implementation mirrors Python RecoveryCountdown class from timing/sfn.py and supports both hardware timer-based operation (production) and tick-based polling (testing).
